comment:
Section 4.3.3, Line 331: A small extension mentioning IHE having profiled some eH use-cases in the FHIR standard. We think it would be helpful to point this out in this chapter, so that the reader gets the information that some use-cases are already profiled in terms of services and transactions and they can profit from. Feel free to formulate a better expression or location of this thought.
Inserted in the .docx, at the end of the paragraph: "A number of widely-used digital health use-cases are profiled by IHE using the FHIR standard and RESTful APIs. Those profiles constrain FHIR in a way so that the workflows of the use-case can be optimally fulfilled by technical systems and sustainability is maximized (search parameters, content, response, …)."

Section 4.3.3, Line 331: A small extension mentioning IHE having profiled some eH use-cases in the FHIR standard. We think it would be helpful to point this out in this chapter, so that the reader gets the information that some use-cases are already profiled in terms of services and transactions and they can profit from. Feel free to formulate a better expression or location of this thought.
Inserted in the .docx, at the end of the paragraph: "A number of widely-used digital health use-cases are profiled by IHE using the FHIR standard and RESTful APIs. Those profiles constrain FHIR in a way so that the workflows of the use-case can be optimally fulfilled by technical systems and sustainability is maximized (search parameters, content, response, …)."
